requirements.quote: `forgedock stats --card [--week|--month]`: a shareable summary (SVG/PNG + Markdown) for one repo or all repos: PRs merged, issues completed, cost per merge, issues closed before code (invalid/duplicate), release-gate catches, time saved estimate clearly labelled as an estimate.

requirements.why: PNG needs a rasterizer dependency; SVG and Markdown ship now and the issue allows SVG/PNG.

requirements.quote: Contains no private code, titles or repo names unless the user opts in (`--include-repo-names`); public repos may link to the run history.
The card renders from local stats data without network calls beyond the existing stats crawl.
Defaults expose only aggregate numbers; a test asserts no issue titles or private repo names appear unless opted in.

deliverables.change: buildCard, renderCardMarkdown, renderCardSvg: aggregate-only, repo name only on opt-in, estimate label, attribution footer, escaped SVG
flags --card --week --month --include-repo-names --public-repo --out, HELP, readAttribution, dispatch reusing the existing crawl only
tests incl. no titles/repo names by default and stubbed-gh runStats --card
document --card, estimate constant, attribution, and that PNG is not shipped

preserve.what: Existing stats modes and output (bin/stats/render.mjs, runStats non-card paths in bin/stats/index.mjs) are unchanged

decisions.choice: Ship SVG + Markdown only, no PNG; no new dependency
decisions.justification: No rasterizer in package.json; issue allows 'SVG/PNG'

decisions.choice: Release-gate catches = sum of blocked acceptance, diffSize, ci and liveness gate events
decisions.justification: docs/TELEMETRY.md lists no distinct release-gate event; bin/stats/aggregate.mjs gates block

decisions.choice: Read branding.show_attribution via parseForgeYaml, default true
decisions.justification: Same pattern as readAlertConfig in bin/stats/index.mjs; documented at docs/CONFIG.md
